title: Burnt Offerings
summary: Burnt offerings were sacrifices wholly offered to God and often connected with worship, atonement, dedication, and surrender.
background: The burnt offering emphasized consecration before the Lord. The entire offering going up in smoke pictured total devotion and acceptance by God’s provision.
teachingHelp: Use burnt offering passages to point toward the seriousness of sin, the costliness of worship, and the fullness of Christ’s self-giving.
